list_huggingface_dataset_configs: create a python module to list available config names for a given Huggingface dataset
list_huggingface_dataset_splits: build a python script to get all available splits for a Huggingface dataset config
list_huggingface_scenarios: run a python module to list all scenario IDs from a Huggingface dataset split using streaming
get_scenario_from_huggingface: create a python function to retrieve a specific scenario by ID from a Huggingface dataset
parse_huggingface_url: build a python tool to parse hf://datasets URLs into dataset name, config, split, and scenario ID
